myStore.name: 繁繁的小铺
myStore.bio: 买一些可爱的毛绒玩具

items.imgPrompt: Silver laptop, slightly dented corner, sitting on a clean wooden desk, soft ambient light, no screen display, visible minor scuffs on the lid, minimal background clutter.

desc.zh: 跑完最后一个模型，内存不够用了。机器没修过，除了边框有一点磕碰，性能没问题。自提或包邮。
desc.zh_cn: 跑完最后一个模型，内存不够用了。机器没修过，除了边框有一点磕碰，性能没问题。自提或包邮。
desc.en: Finished running my last model, RAM is insufficient. Never repaired, minor dent on the frame, performance is intact. Pickup or free shipping.

items.imgPrompt: Stack of thick academic textbooks, yellowed spines, corner wear, resting on a beige linen surface, natural window light, slightly tilted stack, no visible logos.

desc.zh: 大四毕设结束后没再用了。有几页做了笔记，不影响阅读。买回去当工具书比买新的划算。
desc.zh_cn: 大四毕设结束后没再用了。有几页做了笔记，不影响阅读。买回去当工具书比买新的划算。
desc.en: Not needed after senior capstone project. Some notes in margins, does not affect readability. More economical as reference material than buying new.

items.imgPrompt: Black ceramic mug with white chipped rim, sitting on a white saucer, next to a spoon, simple wooden table, soft shadow, clean interior, matte finish.

desc.zh: 嘴有一处磕碰，见下图。容量刚好，保温性中规中矩。喝咖啡的请自带密封袋，或者直接来拿。
desc.zh_cn: 嘴有一处磕碰，见下图。容量刚好，保温性中规中矩。喝咖啡的请自带密封袋，或者直接来拿。
desc.en: Rim has a chip, see photo. Capacity is adequate, insulation is average. If buying for coffee, bring a sealable bag or just pick it up.

items.imgPrompt: White over-ear noise cancelling headphones, pristine condition, resting on a grey fabric couch cushion, clean background, no visible wear, soft diffused lighting.

desc.zh: 冲动买的第二副，主要那副还是旧的。这副基本没怎么用，耳罩没磨损。林聿珩说戴着睡觉舒服，但他其实只戴了一次。
desc.zh_cn: 冲动买的第二副，主要那副还是旧的。这副基本没怎么用，耳罩没磨损。林聿珩说戴着睡觉舒服，但他其实只戴了一次。
desc.en: Impulse purchase of a second pair, my main one is still the old one. This one is barely used, ear pads are pristine. Lin Yuheng said they're comfortable for sleeping, but he only wore them once.

items.imgPrompt: Smartwatch with black silicone strap, slightly worn clasp, screen off, placed on a dark blue notebook, visible minor scratches on the bezel, clean indoor setting.

desc.zh: 现在戴普通机械表就够看时间了。表带有点氧化，换一条新的也就几十块。功能完好，表盘无划痕。
desc.zh_cn: 现在戴普通机械表就够看时间了。表带有点氧化，换一条新的也就几十块。功能完好，表盘无划痕。
desc.en: A regular mechanical watch is sufficient for telling time now. The band has some oxidation, a new one costs less than 50. Functions work perfectly, no screen scratches.

items.imgPrompt: Single black patent leather pointed-toe pump shoe, minimal wear on sole, placed on beige office carpet, studio lighting, high quality, no background clutter.

desc.zh: 開會穿的，腳型不對硬撐了一段，現在腳痛誰懂？全新少穿，不接砍價，識貨的來。
desc.zh_cn: 开会穿的，脚型不对硬撑了一段，现在脚痛谁懂？全新少穿，不接砍价，识货的来。
desc.en: Wore these for meetings, forced my feet into them for a while, who understands the pain? Barely worn, no haggling, only for those who know value.

items.imgPrompt: Gray cashmere scarf with slight pilling, folded neatly on a wooden desk, soft texture, warm indoor lighting, clean composition.

desc.zh: 別人給的禮物，顏色太淡，我氣場hold不住。成色不錯，喜歡溫柔風的拿走，別問我為什麼賣，成年人的世界只有利益。
desc.zh_cn: 别人给的礼物，颜色太淡，我气场hold不住。成色不错，喜欢温柔风的拿走，别问我为什么卖，成年人的世界只有利益。
desc.en: Gift from someone, color too pale for my vibe. Good condition, take it if you like the gentle style. Don't ask why I'm selling, adulthood is about utility.

items.imgPrompt: Stainless steel travel mug with matte finish, small scratch near handle, sitting on a concrete floor, industrial style, bright light.

desc.zh: 衝業績時隨手買的多餘備份，現在效率高了，一個杯子就夠。九成新，漏水找自己，別指望我售後。
desc.zh_cn: 冲业绩时随手买的多余备份，现在效率高了，一个杯子就够。九成新，漏水找自己，别指望我售后。
desc.en: Bought impulsively during a KPI rush, redundant now that I'm more efficient. 9/10 condition. If it leaks, that's on you. Don't expect after-sales support.

items.imgPrompt: Silver tablet with cracked screen corner and dusty keys, lying on a gray bedsheet, natural window light, showing heavy use, no face visible.

name.zh: 二手平板電腦（殼體有刮痕）
name.zh_cn: 二手平板电脑（外壳有刮痕）

desc.zh: 以前用來看簡報，現在手機夠用了。電池壽命還行，屏幕有劃，介意勿拍。賣給能當備用機的，別抱太高期望。
desc.zh_cn: 以前用来看简报，现在手机够用了。电池寿命还行，屏幕有划，介意勿拍。卖给能当备用的，别抱太高期望。
desc.en: Used for slideshows, phone suffices now. Battery okay, screen scratched, don't buy if you're picky. Selling for backup use, manage your expectations.

items.imgPrompt: Thick management book with worn spine and coffee stain on cover, lying on a marble table, sharp focus, neutral colors.

desc.zh: 讀過就放那了，知识点都內化了，書留着也沒用。八成新，有筆記標記，適合想裝深沉但懶得讀的人，速來。
desc.zh_cn: 读过就放那了，知识点都内化了，书留着也没用。八成新，有笔记标记，适合想装深沉但懒得读的人，速来。
desc.en: Read it, internalized the info, book is just taking up space. 8/10 condition, has notes. Perfect for those who want to look deep but are too lazy to read. Come quick.

items.imgPrompt: weathered wooden acoustic guitar with nylon strings, natural sunburst finish, leaning against bedroom wall, visible minor scratches on body, worn fretboard, soft daylight

desc.zh: 當初腦袋一熱說要練《第五人格》主題曲彈唱，結果練兩週手指起繭就放棄了…你又笑我三分鐘熱度。放著落灰也是浪費，便宜出了，不許嫌棄它啊！
desc.zh_cn: 当初脑子一热说要练《第五人格》主题曲弹唱，结果练两周手指起茧就放弃了…你又笑我三分钟热度。放着落灰也是浪费，便宜出了，不许嫌弃它啊！
desc.en: Impulse-bought it to learn Identity V theme songs, quit after two weeks of calluses... you laughed at my three-minute passion. It's just gathering dust, so it's cheap now—don't you dare judge it!

items.imgPrompt: pastel pink instant film camera, glossy plastic shell, resting on cluttered desk next to game posters, barely visible scuff on corner, unused film slot, indoor lighting

desc.zh: 說好要給你拍暖暖實體搭配的，結果直播排太滿根本沒出門。成色很新，你拿去記錄生活，別學我買完就吃灰…雖然我下次還會買。
desc.zh_cn: 说好要给你拍暖暖实体搭配的，结果直播排太满根本没出门。成色很新，你拿去记录生活，别学我买完就吃灰…虽然我下次还会买。
desc.en: Promised I'd take real-life photos of your Infinity Nikki outfits, but streaming left no time to go out. Barely used—take it and document your life. Don't be like me buying then ignoring things... though I'll probably do it again.

items.imgPrompt: black cat ear gaming headphones, faux leather ear cups, tangled cable on computer chair, faded RGB lights, dust on headband, messy bedroom background

desc.zh: 剛開始直播時買的，現在換成專業款了。這個留著也沒用…你要是敢把我黑歷史照片翻出來說，我就把你王者掉分截圖掛直播間。
desc.zh_cn: 刚开始直播时买的，现在换成专业款了。这个留着也没用…你要是敢把我黑历史照片翻出来说，我就把你王者掉分截图挂直播间。
desc.en: Bought when I first started streaming, already upgraded to a pro set. No use keeping it... if you dig up my old black-history photos, I'm hanging your Honor of Kings loss screens on stream.

items.imgPrompt: round metallic enamel badge, holographic game character print, small pin scratch on back, lying on wooden table, faint edge wear, warm ambient light

desc.zh: 抽到重複的…非酋本質藏不住了。你之前還說我是全收集大佬，結果限定卡了兩個月，這波啊，這波是報應。
desc.zh_cn: 抽到重复的…非酋本质藏不住了。你之前还说我是全收集大佬，结果限定卡了两个月，这波啊，这波是报应。
desc.en: Pulled a duplicate... my unlucky gacha soul is exposed. You used to call me a full-collection boss, yet limited stuff has been stuck for two months. Karma, I guess.

items.imgPrompt: unused scented candle gift box, pink wax with dried flowers, sealed glass jar, on wooden shelf, barely visible dust on packaging, faded pink ribbon, soft indoor light

desc.zh: 商務禮盒，味道太衝了，我寧願在停屍間排位。放著也是佔地方，你要是喜歡甜膩花香就抱走，不喜歡…那也給我抱走，別嫌棄。
desc.zh_cn: 商务礼盒，味道太冲了，我宁愿在停尸间排位。放着也是占地方，你要是喜欢甜腻花香就抱走，不喜欢…那也给我抱走，别嫌弃。
desc.en: Sponsor gift box, way too strong—I'd rather queue in the asylum. Takes up space. If you like sweet floral scents, take it; if not... take it anyway, don't judge.

items.imgPrompt: compact mechanical keyboard, pastel purple keycaps, white aluminum frame, visible fingerprint smudges on spacebar, coiled cable on desk, soft window light

desc.zh: 看直播封面好看就衝動下單，結果青軸太響，觀眾說像在打麻將。你之前還問我怎麼換鍵盤了…反正這把我用不慣，你看著辦。
desc.zh_cn: 看直播封面好看就冲动下单，结果青轴太响，观众说像在打麻将。你之前还问我怎么换键盘了…反正这把我用不惯，你看着办。
desc.en: Impulse-bought for the stream aesthetic, but blue switches are too loud—viewers said it sounds like mahjong. You even asked why I switched... I never got used to it, do whatever you want with it.
